report: Fresh review of the complete claim, sole implementation association, and sole annotated test. Verified exact byte equality of current lib.rs and service_spec.rs to the supplied historical snapshots; the prior report is context, while this assessment independently checks current fragments. Requirements are durable URL intent rather than response state; history updates for selection, product, search, grown panel, and revision views; complete response-state invalidation on revision mismatch followed by current-directory fetch and canonical symbol/product replay; and revision checks on every event-stream connection to close disconnected notification gaps. The lib.rs not_applicable association explicitly assigns URL/navigation to the TypeScript browser: appropriate for this Rust evidence boundary, not a claim that the browser requirements are unnecessary or proven. The complete service_spec test is explicitly TODO and has no behavior or assertions. Its prerequisite is associating and reviewing complete browser evidence for direct loads, Back/Forward, replace versus push, missing targets, reconnect and revision events, checking both restored views and API demand. Those scenarios must establish all listed intent dimensions, invalidation/replay ordering and reconnect freshness before implementation/test approval; they are presently deferred. A stale retained response or missed reconnect revision would not be detected by this empty test, so no behavioral coverage is claimed. The prior TODO/N/A rationale remains sufficient for the visible deferral; no additional helper source is relied on. Executed review start/read and byte comparisons only, with record to follow; no browser or behavioral tests were executed. Coordinator-reported 321 passing sage-meta tests and cargo build are separate prior execution, not proof of this browser claim. Accepting this accounting leaves TODO/N/A visible and does not approve unfinished navigation behavior.
